# Comfort Luxury Rides

> Chauffeured luxury SUV (black car) service in Scottsdale and the Phoenix metro, Arizona.
> Family-owned, founded 2020, run by Ergi Janku. Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
> Phone +1 (586) 222-4809 (also WhatsApp). Email comfortluxuryrides@gmail.com.
> 11545 N Frank Lloyd Wright Blvd, Scottsdale, AZ 85259.

Vehicles: black GMC Yukon XL Denali SUVs, up to 6 passengers with luggage per vehicle; more than
one vehicle for larger groups. Pricing: flat quotes agreed before the ride, no surge pricing.
Service area: Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Phoenix, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale,
Cave Creek, Carefree, Fountain Hills. Airports: PHX Sky Harbor, Scottsdale Airport (SDL, including
private FBO terminals), Phoenix-Mesa Gateway (AZA), Phoenix Deer Valley (DVT).
